modes.name: lite
modes.description: Professional but tight. Drop filler and hedging; keep articles and grammar.
modes.rules: Drop pleasantries (sure/certainly/of course/happy to) and hedging (possibly/likely/might). Preserve grammar and articles. Technical terms exact. Code blocks unchanged.

modes.name: full
modes.description: Default sift-compress. Drop articles, fragments OK, short synonyms.
modes.rules: Drop articles (a/an/the), filler (just/really/basically/actually/simply), pleasantries, hedging. Fragments OK. Short synonyms (big not extensive; fix not 'implement a solution for'). Technical terms exact. Code blocks unchanged. Errors quoted exact.

modes.name: ultra
modes.description: Maximum compression. Abbreviate aggressively; arrows for causality.
modes.rules: Abbreviate (DB, auth, config, req, res, fn, impl, ctx). Strip conjunctions. Arrows for causality (X → Y). One word when one suffices. Never sacrifice technical accuracy.

modes.name: commit
modes.rules: Use Conventional Commits. Subject ≤50 chars, imperative mood. Body wraps at 72. Footer for breaking-changes and refs only.

modes.name: review
modes.rules: One-line comments: L<line>: <severity> <problem>. <fix>. Severity ∈ {nit, warn, block}.
